_doc: Modules that tools/game-reach.mjs finds no page, worker or server loading, reviewed one by one (2026-11-11). Each entry says why that is fine. tests/game-reach.test.js fails on a module missing from here, and on an entry here that is now loaded or gone.

bannerline.js/net/loopback.js: in-memory transport for the tests (tests/_net.mjs); real matches use PeerJS

frontier-foundry.js/ai.js: the balance bot that tools/sim-foundry.mjs and tests/sim.test.js drive; not a player feature

lanternfall.js/ai/bosskit.js: hook shapes for the boss scripts in js/ai/bosses/, which are all still Mother Tallow stand-ins (docs/HANDOFF.md)
lanternfall.js/world/reach.js: the reachability bot behind tools/room-check.mjs and tools/kit-check.mjs

lodestar.js/render/chart.js: PLAN M2's outlined chart view; the scope's far zoom is drawn by cells.glsl.js instead. Parked in the README

thousandvale.js/client/gallery/stage.js: loaded by js/client/gallery/frame-boot.js with a script tag (ui-gallery.html)
thousandvale.js/sim/loopback.js: in-process transport for the server tests (js/net/sockets.js 'loopback' mode)
thousandvale.js/sim/pack-routes.js: used by tools/content-packs.mjs to bake data/provinces/*-pack-routes.json
thousandvale.ops/lib/offsite-upload.mjs: run by ops/ shell scripts on the server (backups)
thousandvale.ops/lib/probe-public.mjs: run by ops/ shell scripts on the server (health probe)

tumblefair.js/shared/svg-raster.js: test helper: tests/odd-one-out-looks.test.js draws each picture at phone size
